verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is API-first. Its documented API overview covers token auth, async operations via the `Prefer: respond-async` header and compression behavior. It also documents write, query, namespace and metadata endpoints in detail, ships official SDKs in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Ruby and Rust, and serves an llms.txt for agent consumption. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
